services.name: Dolphin Watch Sail Deluxe • Lahaina
services.desc: Enjoy a deluxe 3-hour dolphin watch plus a delicious lunch onboard our state-of-the-art vessel. Approximately 3 hours. About Experience the thrill of watching dolphins in the wild on our state-of-the-art luxury sailing vessel, Ocean Spirit. This deluxe dolphin watch experience will run with a maximum capacity of only 35 people and will include lunch and refreshments. See acrobatic spinner dolphins, friendly bottlenose dolphins, and curious spotted dolphins while our certified Marine Naturalists interpret their behaviors and share fascinating facts about wild dolphin characteristics 3 hours • All ages • 3-hour dolphin watch plus a delicious lunch onboard!

services.name: Molokini & Turtle Arches Snorkel • Ma'alaea
services.desc: Snorkel with the experts at world-famous Molokini reef, plus a second snorkel spot known for green sea turtles and underwater lava arches. Approximately 5 hours. About Molokini, Maui’s iconic crescent-shaped islet, is a beautiful reef known for its crystal clear waters, abundant coral, colorful fish, and resting seabirds. A protected marine conservation area, this volcanic crater is only accessible by boat with a certified tour operator. Turtle Arches offers a bonus snorkel site with its underwater lava formations and frequent turtle sightings. Continental breakfast is included and a 5 hours • All ages • Snorkel with the experts at world-famous Molokini reef!

services.name: Sunset Dinner Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a guaranteed private table for your party to experience a delicious chef-prepared four-course dinner served table side by our attentive crew. Approximately 2.5 hours. About Our award-winner Sunset Dinner Cruise is an island experience not to be missed. All entrees are freshly grilled onboard during your cruise and all guests are guaranteed outdoor seating. Dinner includes appetizers, locally grown salad, a choice of entrées, dessert and an array of drinks and cocktails. Island-style music and open sea views along Maui’s scenic coast add to the ambience of this memorable 2.5 hours • All ages • Includes a private table and premium drinks

services.name: Honolua Snorkel & Dolphin Sail • Lahaina
services.desc: Come aboard Ocean Spirit, our luxury sailing catamaran, on this exclusive experience up the beautiful West Maui and Ka'anapali coastline to the breathtaking waters of Honolua Bay. Running at 50% capacity, this experience to give you plenty of room to enjoy the experience. Approximately 6 hours About Honolua Bay is protected as a marine conservation area and is one of Maui’s most scenic snorkel spots. Snorkel at two secluded spots popular with sea turtles, colorful fish, and vibrant coral. Wild dolphin sightings are also common, as are humpback whales from December to April. 5 hours • All ages • Cruise the beautiful Ka'anapali coastline to the waters of Honolua Bay!

services.name: Sunset & Celestial Cruise • Ma'alaea
services.desc: Take a journey at sea with Pacific Whale Foundation and international award-winning astronomy writer and speaker Harriet Witt to experience our “Moving Planet”. Approximately 2.5 hours. About During this new and improved version of our original Stargazing cruise, you’ll enjoy delicious appetizers, drinks and Maui’s famous sunsets while learning about Polynesian navigation (wayfinding) and how these amazing people utilized the stars to find the Hawaiian Islands. Once the sun sets and stars begin to appear, Harriet will highlight specific stars to observe and relate stories about their 2.5 hours • All ages • Enjoy delicious appetizers, drinks and Maui’s famous sunsets, then stargaze!

services.name: Molokini & Turtle Adventure
services.desc: Visit world famous Molokini Crater on this small-group experience, with a second, expertly-selected location that is based on a customized itinerary for the day Approximately 6 hours. About Each adventure carries no more than 34 guests on Ocean Explorer, a 54 ft. single deck catamaran with open seating and unimpeded views – so there’s plenty of room to move around and enjoy the views. Snorkel the iconic volcanic crater and its beautiful reef known for crystal clear waters, abundant coral, colorful fish, and resting seabirds. A flexible itinerary includes visiting a second snorkel 5 hours

services.name: Sunset Sail • Lahaina
services.desc: Enjoy tantalizing pupus (appetizers) and island-style music against the backdrop of a stunning sunset over the Pacific Ocean. Approximately 2 hours. About This relaxing cruise is aboard Maui's newest luxury sailing catamaran, Ocean Spirit. It’s the perfect way to experience the essence of ho’okipa (hospitality), as our crew serves an array of premium appetizers along with tropical cocktails, champagne, wine and other refreshing beverages. Departs from historic Lahaina Harbor. Not recommended for pregnant women or those with back or mobility issues. Includes Appetizers: black pepper 2 hours • All ages • Enjoy tantalizing pupus and island-style music with a stunning sunset!

services.name: Lanai Snorkel & Dolphin Sail • Lahaina
services.desc: See dolphins in the wild and discover the largely uninhabited coast of Lana'i, one of the world’s top 10 snorkel locations. Approximately 5 hours. About Cruise to the scenic coastline of Lana'i island and snorkel a dazzling coral reef, home to abundant sea life. Wild dolphins are found in bays and offshore, including acrobatic spinner dolphins, friendly bottlenose dolphins, and curious spotted dolphins. Sightings of humpback whales are also common from December to April. Includes Certified Marine Naturalists onboard Premium snorkel gear, including optical masks for eyeglass wearers 5 hours • All ages • See dolphins in the wild and discover the largely uninhabited coast of Lana'i

services.name: Maui Snorkel & Sunset Sail • Lahaina
services.desc: The Wikiwiki Express is a small group experience and our most economical, eco-friendly morning cruise to Molokini! 3.5 Hours About Enjoy Molokini during the best morning snorkel conditions while leaving your afternoon free to schedule other activities and maximize your vacation fun on Maui. The Molokini Eco-Express departs from conveniently located Ma’alaea Harbor and cruises directly to Molokini Marine Preserve. We provide all the snorkel gear, including sanitized masks and snorkels, fins, swim noodles and other flotation devices. There’s even a "Learn to Snorkel" class for 4 hours • All ages

services.name: Whalewatch Sail • Ma'alaea
services.desc: Experience Maui's top-rated whalewatch aboard Maui’s newest eco-friendly sailing vessel, Ocean Spirit. Approximately 2 hours. About Ocean Spirit is a state-of-the-art catamaran offering luxury, space and comfort for a maximum capacity of 49 passengers. Whalewatch Sail is led by certified Marine Naturalists for fun and informative interpretation of humpback whale behaviors and characteristics. We sail when possible depending on weather conditions or whale activity and may need to use our engines for the safety of the animals, in accordance with our “Be Whale Aware” policies for safe 2 hours • All ages • Experience Maui's top-rated whalewatch aboard our eco-friendly sailing vessel!
